title: 無振動精密實驗平台~Vibration-isolated precision platforms
focus: 傳遞率、氣墊隔振腳、蜂巢桌面柔度、VC 樓板準則與熱聲漂移預算~Transmissibility, pneumatic legs, honeycomb compliance, VC floor criteria and thermal-acoustic drift budgets
summary: 以一張 1000 kg 蜂巢光學桌與四支 1.5 Hz 氣墊隔振腳為主線，說明樓板 VC 等級如何經傳遞率變成桌面奈米級運動，再把桌面模態、主動隔振的傾斜極限、熱與聲學漂移和管線振動短路整合成可量測、可交接的平台驗收紀錄。~Follow a 1000 kg honeycomb optical table on four 1.5 Hz pneumatic legs to see how a floor VC class becomes nanometre tabletop motion through transmissibility, then integrate table modes, the tilt limit of active isolation, thermal and acoustic drift and vibration short circuits through hoses into a measurable, transferable platform acceptance record.

units.title: 傳遞率、自然頻率與阻尼取捨~Transmissibility, natural frequency and the damping trade-off
units.mechanism: 無振動平台的核心是一個質量—彈簧—阻尼系統：桌面質量 m 坐在剛度 k 的支撐上，自然頻率 f₀ = (1/2π)√(k/m)。地面運動以傳遞率 T(f) 傳到桌面：f 遠低於 f₀ 時桌面跟著地面走（T ≈ 1），f = f₀ 時共振放大，只有在 f > √2·f₀ 之後才開始隔振，無阻尼時隨 (f/f₀)⁻² 下降。阻尼壓低共振峰，卻在高頻把衰減斜率從 40 dB/decade 拉回到約 20 dB/decade，因此精密平台必須在共振放大與高頻隔振之間取捨。要把 f₀ 壓到 1 到 2 Hz，靜變形 δ = g/(2πf₀)² 必須達到十公分等級，這是鋼彈簧做不到、改用空氣彈簧的根本原因。~A vibration-isolated platform is at heart a mass–spring–damper: the tabletop mass m sits on supports of stiffness k with natural frequency f0 = (1/2π)√(k/m). Ground motion reaches the top through the transmissibility T(f): well below f0 the top follows the ground (T ≈ 1), at f0 it is amplified, and isolation starts only above √2·f0, falling as (f/f0)⁻² when undamped. Damping lowers the resonant peak but at high frequency pulls the roll-off from 40 dB/decade back toward 20 dB/decade, so a precision platform trades resonant amplification against high-frequency isolation. Pushing f0 to 1 to 2 Hz demands a static deflection δ = g/(2πf0)² of order ten centimetres, which steel springs cannot provide and is the basic reason for air springs.
units.model: 無阻尼 T = 1/|1 − (f/f₀)²|：f₀ = 1.5 Hz、f = 10 Hz 時 r = 6.67，T = 1/(44.4 − 1) ≈ 0.023（−32.8 dB）。加阻尼比 ζ = 0.1 後 T = √(1 + (2ζr)²)/√((1 − r²)² + (2ζr)²) ≈ 0.038，共振峰 T(f₀) ≈ 5.1。若用鋼彈簧做 1.5 Hz，需靜變形 δ = 9.81/(2π×1.5)² ≈ 0.11 m；10 Hz 的橡膠墊只需 2.5 mm，但在 10 Hz 完全不隔振。~Undamped, T = 1/|1 − (f/f0)²|: with f0 = 1.5 Hz and f = 10 Hz, r = 6.67 and T = 1/(44.4 − 1) ≈ 0.023 (−32.8 dB). With a damping ratio ζ = 0.1, T = √(1 + (2ζr)²)/√((1 − r²)² + (2ζr)²) ≈ 0.038 and the resonant peak T(f0) ≈ 5.1. A 1.5 Hz steel spring would need a static deflection δ = 9.81/(2π×1.5)² ≈ 0.11 m, whereas a 10 Hz rubber pad needs only 2.5 mm but gives no isolation at 10 Hz.
units.verify: 在地面與桌面同時放置地震儀或加速度計，以環境振動或小型激振器為輸入，計算 H(f) = S_xy/S_xx 與相干函數，讀出共振頻率、峰值與高頻斜率，並與所選 f₀、ζ 的模型曲線疊圖；垂直與兩個水平方向都要量。~Place seismometers or accelerometers on the floor and on the tabletop simultaneously, use ambient vibration or a small shaker as input, compute H(f) = S_xy/S_xx with its coherence, read off the resonance, peak value and high-frequency slope, and overlay the model curve for the chosen f0 and ζ; measure the vertical and both horizontal axes.
units.failure: 為了加快沉降而把阻尼調得過高，共振峰雖降到 2 以下，但 10 到 30 Hz 的隔振量損失一半以上，正好落在建築與機台最常見的振動頻段；反之阻尼不足時，人走過或關門會激起持續數秒的 1 到 2 Hz 晃動。~Raising damping to speed settling pulls the resonant peak below 2 but loses more than half the isolation from 10 to 30 Hz, exactly where building and machinery vibration is most common; with too little damping, footsteps or a closing door excite seconds of 1 to 2 Hz sway.
units.misconception: 隔振器在任何頻率都能減少振動，自然頻率附近也一樣。~An isolator reduces vibration at every frequency, including near its natural frequency.

units.anchor: 樓板振動頻譜與 VC 曲線~Floor vibration spectrum and VC curves
units.title: 環境輸入：樓板 VC 準則、聲學與熱源~Environmental input: floor VC criteria, acoustics and heat sources
units.mechanism: 平台設計從場址的輸入開始。通用振動準則（VC 曲線）以三分之一倍頻帶的 rms 速度規範樓板：VC-A 50 µm/s、VC-B 25、VC-C 12.5、VC-D 6.25、VC-E 3.12 µm/s，每級減半，在約 1 到 80 Hz 範圍內為定值。以速度定義代表在固定速度下位移 x = v/(2πf) 隨頻率下降，所以低頻的位移最大，也最難隔離。振動之外，空調氣流、聲壓與局部熱源會直接作用在桌面上的元件，不經過隔振器，必須另外列入預算。~Platform design starts from the site input. The generic vibration criteria (VC curves) specify floor motion as one-third-octave rms velocity: VC-A 50 µm/s, VC-B 25, VC-C 12.5, VC-D 6.25 and VC-E 3.12 µm/s, halving at each step and flat over roughly 1 to 80 Hz. A velocity criterion means displacement x = v/(2πf) falls with frequency at constant velocity, so low frequencies carry the largest displacement and are the hardest to isolate. Beyond vibration, HVAC airflow, sound pressure and local heat sources act directly on components on the tabletop without passing through the isolators and must be budgeted separately.
units.model: VC-C 樓板在 8 Hz 頻帶：x = 12.5×10⁻⁶/(2π×8) ≈ 249 nm；經 f₀ = 1.5 Hz、ζ = 0.1 的隔振器（T ≈ 0.053）後桌面約 13 nm。16 Hz 頻帶：124 nm × 0.021 ≈ 2.6 nm；31.5 Hz：63 nm × 0.0098 ≈ 0.6 nm。但若 2 Hz 頻帶達到 VC-C 上限，995 nm 經 T ≈ 1.26 反被放大到約 1.25 µm，顯示 VC 等級本身無法描述隔振器共振附近的風險。~On a VC-C floor in the 8 Hz band, x = 12.5×10⁻⁶/(2π×8) ≈ 249 nm; through an isolator with f0 = 1.5 Hz and ζ = 0.1 (T ≈ 0.053) the tabletop moves about 13 nm. In the 16 Hz band 124 nm × 0.021 ≈ 2.6 nm, and at 31.5 Hz 63 nm × 0.0098 ≈ 0.6 nm. A 2 Hz band at the VC-C limit, 995 nm, is instead amplified by T ≈ 1.26 to about 1.25 µm, showing that a VC class alone cannot describe the risk near the isolator resonance.
units.verify: 在預定位置以低雜訊地震儀量測至少 24 小時，涵蓋上班時段與夜間，轉成三分之一倍頻帶 rms 速度頻譜並與 VC 曲線疊圖；同時以聲級計量 31.5 Hz 到 1 kHz 的聲壓頻譜，以多點溫度記錄器量空調週期造成的溫度波動。~Survey the intended location with a low-noise seismometer for at least 24 hours covering working hours and night, convert to one-third-octave rms velocity spectra and overlay the VC curves; at the same time record the sound-pressure spectrum from 31.5 Hz to 1 kHz with a sound-level meter and the HVAC-cycle temperature swing with multi-point loggers.
units.failure: 只看單一頻帶的最大值而忽略頻譜形狀，可能放過 2 到 4 Hz 的樓板共振；平台裝好後該頻段剛好落在隔振器放大區，影像或干涉訊號出現週期性晃動，事後只能改樓板或改用主動隔振。~Judging only the peak band level while ignoring spectral shape can miss a 2 to 4 Hz floor resonance; once the platform is installed that band falls in the isolator's amplification region, images or interference signals show periodic sway, and the remedy becomes a floor retrofit or active isolation.
units.misconception: 樓板達到 VC-C，放上去的任何儀器都能達到奈米穩定。~A VC-C floor guarantees nanometre stability for any instrument placed on it.

units.anchor: 氣墊隔振腳與水平閥~Pneumatic isolator leg and leveling valve
units.title: 氣墊隔振腳：空氣彈簧、阻尼孔與自動水平~Pneumatic legs: air spring, damping orifice and auto-leveling
units.mechanism: 氣墊隔振腳以橡膠膜片封住加壓氣室，活塞面積 A 承載重量 W = p_g·A，剛度來自氣體壓縮 k = n·p_abs·A²/V，因此自然頻率只取決於壓力比與等效高度 V/A，而與負載大小無關。兩個氣室之間以層流阻尼孔相連，氣體來回流動消耗能量提供阻尼；水平方向則以內部擺桿或膜片側向柔性形成約 1.5 Hz 的擺。機械式水平閥偵測桌面高度，自動補氣或排氣，使不同負載下高度回到原位，但閥的死區與反應時間會影響沉降與漂移。~A pneumatic leg seals a pressurized chamber with a rubber diaphragm; the piston area A carries the weight W = p_g·A, and stiffness comes from gas compression, k = n·p_abs·A²/V, so the natural frequency depends only on the pressure ratio and the effective height V/A, not on the load. Two chambers joined by a laminar damping orifice dissipate energy as gas flows back and forth, and horizontally an internal pendulum or the diaphragm's lateral compliance forms a pendulum near 1.5 Hz. A mechanical leveling valve senses table height and adds or vents air so the height returns under changing loads, but its dead band and response time affect settling and drift.
units.model: 將 k 與 W 代入得 f₀ = (1/2π)√(n·g·p_abs/(p_g·h_eff))。取 n = 1.4、p_g = 4 bar、p_abs ≈ 5 bar、h_eff = V/A = 0.25 m：f₀ ≈ 1.32 Hz；氣室縮小到 h_eff = 0.1 m 時 f₀ ≈ 2.09 Hz。1000 kg 桌面由四腳分擔，每腳 2452 N，需 A = 2452/(4×10⁵) ≈ 6.1×10⁻³ m²（直徑約 88 mm）。水平擺長 L = 0.1 m 時 f_h = (1/2π)√(g/L) ≈ 1.58 Hz。~Substituting k and W gives f0 = (1/2π)√(n·g·p_abs/(p_g·h_eff)). With n = 1.4, p_g = 4 bar, p_abs ≈ 5 bar and h_eff = V/A = 0.25 m, f0 ≈ 1.32 Hz; shrinking the chamber to h_eff = 0.1 m raises f0 to about 2.09 Hz. A 1000 kg top shared by four legs puts 2452 N on each, requiring A = 2452/(4×10⁵) ≈ 6.1×10⁻³ m², about 88 mm in diameter. A horizontal pendulum of length L = 0.1 m gives f_h = (1/2π)√(g/L) ≈ 1.58 Hz.
units.verify: 在每支腳旁放位移計，加減已知砝碼量測垂直靜剛度並換算 f₀，與自由衰減法（輕推後記錄衰減曲線，從週期與對數衰減率求 f₀ 與 ζ）交叉比對；水平閥則以加載後回到原高度的時間與殘餘偏差評估。~Put a displacement gauge beside each leg, add and remove known masses to measure vertical static stiffness and convert to f0, and cross-check with a free-decay test (a light push, recording the decay to extract f0 and ζ from the period and logarithmic decrement); evaluate the leveling valves by the time to return to height after loading and the residual offset.
units.failure: 供氣含水氣或油霧時阻尼孔與水平閥被污染，阻尼下降、閥卡住，桌面會緩慢傾斜或持續上下微振；膜片老化漏氣則使某一腳壓力不足，負載轉移到其他腳，四腳 f₀ 不一致並激起搖擺模態。~Supply air carrying moisture or oil mist fouls the damping orifices and leveling valves, reducing damping and sticking valves, so the table slowly tilts or keeps hunting up and down; an aged, leaking diaphragm leaves one leg under-pressured, shifts load to the others, mismatches the four f0 values and excites rocking modes.
units.misconception: 負載越重，氣墊隔振腳的自然頻率就越低。~The heavier the load, the lower a pneumatic leg's natural frequency.

units.anchor: 鋼製蜂巢桌面~Steel honeycomb tabletop
units.title: 蜂巢桌面剛性、內部共振與動態柔度~Honeycomb top stiffness, internal resonances and dynamic compliance
units.mechanism: 隔振腳決定桌面整體跟地面的關係，桌面本身的彎曲與扭轉模態則決定桌上兩個元件之間的相對運動。蜂巢桌面以上下鋼板夾著薄鋼蜂巢芯，像工字梁一樣把材料放在離中性面最遠處，以低質量換取高彎曲剛度；但金屬結構的內阻尼很小，模態品質因數 Q 可達 100，任何落在共振頻率的力都會被放大。因此桌面內部要加寬頻阻尼器或調諧質量阻尼器，並以動態柔度曲線（位移／力對頻率）描述，而不只看靜態剛度。~The legs set how the whole top follows the ground, but the top's own bending and torsion modes set the relative motion between two components on it. A honeycomb top sandwiches a thin steel honeycomb core between steel skins, placing material far from the neutral plane like an I-beam to buy bending stiffness with little mass; yet metal structures have little internal damping, so modal quality factors reach 100 and any force at a resonance is amplified. Tops therefore include broadband or tuned-mass dampers and are characterized by a dynamic compliance curve, displacement per unit force versus frequency, rather than static stiffness alone.
units.model: 2.4 m × 1.2 m × 0.3 m、上下鋼板各 5 mm、質量 680 kg 的桌面：I ≈ 2·b·t·(h/2)² = 2.7×10⁻⁴ m⁴，EI = 5.4×10⁷ N·m²，μ = 283 kg/m；自由—自由梁第一彎曲模態 f₁ = (22.37/(2πL²))·√(EI/μ) ≈ 270 Hz（芯材剪切會再拉低）。取模態質量 m/4 = 170 kg，k_modal = m_eff·ω₁² ≈ 4.9×10⁸ N/m；共振處柔度 ≈ Q/k：Q = 100 時 2.0×10⁻⁷ m/N，0.1 N 的風扇力造成約 20 nm，阻尼到 Q = 10 時降為約 2 nm。~For a 2.4 m × 1.2 m × 0.3 m top with 5 mm steel skins and 680 kg mass: I ≈ 2·b·t·(h/2)² = 2.7×10⁻⁴ m⁴, EI = 5.4×10⁷ N·m², μ = 283 kg/m, and the first free–free bending mode is f1 = (22.37/(2πL²))·√(EI/μ) ≈ 270 Hz, lowered further by core shear. Taking a modal mass m/4 = 170 kg gives k_modal = m_eff·ω1² ≈ 4.9×10⁸ N/m; the compliance at resonance ≈ Q/k is 2.0×10⁻⁷ m/N for Q = 100, so a 0.1 N fan force produces about 20 nm, falling to about 2 nm when damping brings Q to 10.
units.verify: 以衝擊錘敲擊桌角、同點加速度計量測響應，計算柔度頻率響應函數，讀出第一彎曲與扭轉模態的頻率與 Q；在桌面多點重複量測繪製模態形狀，並與供應商公布的柔度曲線比較。~Strike a table corner with an impact hammer and measure the response with a co-located accelerometer, compute the compliance frequency-response function and read the frequency and Q of the first bending and torsion modes; repeat at several points to map mode shapes and compare with the supplier's published compliance curve.
units.failure: 把高轉速真空泵或冷卻風扇直接鎖在桌面上，若其轉速諧波落在桌面模態附近，兩個光學元件之間的相對振動會被放大數十倍；症狀是干涉條紋只在特定設備開機時出現固定頻率的抖動。~Bolting a fast vacuum pump or cooling fan directly to the top, with a rotation harmonic near a table mode, amplifies the relative vibration between two optical components tens of times; the symptom is fringe jitter at a fixed frequency only when that equipment runs.
units.misconception: 桌面越重越好，重量本身就能保證桌上元件之間沒有相對運動。~A heavier top is always better because mass alone guarantees no relative motion between components on it.

units.anchor: 地震儀、加速度計與頻譜分析儀~Seismometers, accelerometers and spectrum analyser
units.title: 傳遞率與柔度的量測方法~Measuring transmissibility and compliance
units.mechanism: 驗證平台需要兩種量測：以地面與桌面的感測器對量傳遞率，以敲擊或激振量動態柔度。低頻量測的難點在感測器雜訊：固定位移下加速度 a = (2πf)²x 隨頻率平方下降，1 Hz 時奈米級位移只對應奈克（ng）級加速度，低於一般壓電加速度計的雜訊底線，必須改用地震級加速度計或速度型地震儀。頻率響應以互功率譜估計 H₁ = S_xy/S_xx，並檢查相干函數；相干性低的頻段代表輸出被其他來源主導，結果不可信。~Validating a platform takes two measurements: transmissibility from paired floor and tabletop sensors, and dynamic compliance from impact or shaker excitation. The difficulty at low frequency is sensor noise: at fixed displacement the acceleration a = (2πf)²x falls with frequency squared, so nanometre motion at 1 Hz means only nano-g acceleration, below the noise floor of ordinary piezoelectric accelerometers, and seismic-grade accelerometers or velocity seismometers are needed. The frequency response is estimated from cross-spectra as H1 = S_xy/S_xx and checked with the coherence function; bands of low coherence mean the output is dominated by other sources and the result is not trustworthy.
units.model: 1 Hz、10 nm 位移的加速度 a = (2π×1)²×10⁻⁸ ≈ 3.9×10⁻⁷ m/s² ≈ 40 ng。要解析 f₀ = 1.5 Hz、ζ = 0.1 的共振，半功率頻寬 2ζf₀ = 0.3 Hz，頻率解析度至少取其 1/6 即 0.05 Hz，每段紀錄長 T = 1/Δf = 20 s；平均 30 段把頻譜隨機誤差壓到約 1/√30 ≈ 18%，共需 10 分鐘。~At 1 Hz, 10 nm of displacement is an acceleration a = (2π×1)²×10⁻⁸ ≈ 3.9×10⁻⁷ m/s², about 40 ng. Resolving an f0 = 1.5 Hz, ζ = 0.1 resonance with half-power bandwidth 2ζf0 = 0.3 Hz needs a frequency resolution of at least one sixth of it, 0.05 Hz, so each record is T = 1/Δf = 20 s long; averaging 30 records to cut the spectral random error to about 1/√30 ≈ 18% takes 10 minutes.
units.verify: 量測前把兩個感測器並排放在同一地面做並置測試，兩者的傳遞函數應在全頻段接近 1 且相干性接近 1，差異即為感測器本身的雜訊與增益誤差；之後再分置地面與桌面，並在報告中同時附上相干函數與感測器雜訊底線。~Before measuring, place both sensors side by side on the same floor for a huddle test: their transfer function should be near 1 with coherence near 1 across the band, and any difference is the sensors' own noise and gain error; then separate them to floor and top, and report the coherence function and sensor noise floor together with the result.
units.failure: 用雜訊太高的加速度計量傳遞率，桌面訊號其實是感測器雜訊，算出的傳遞率在 20 Hz 以上變成一條平坦的假底線，讓人誤以為隔振器只有 −20 dB，進而更換本來合格的系統。~Measuring transmissibility with an accelerometer whose noise is too high makes the tabletop signal pure sensor noise, so the computed transmissibility flattens into a false floor above 20 Hz, suggesting the isolators give only −20 dB and prompting replacement of a system that was actually compliant.
units.misconception: 任何加速度計都能量到 1 Hz 的奈米級振動。~Any accelerometer can measure nanometre vibration at 1 Hz.

units.anchor: 相對運動誤差預算表~Relative-motion error budget
units.title: 相對位移預算：熱漂移、空氣折射與聲學~Relative-displacement budget: thermal drift, air index and acoustics
units.mechanism: 平台上的實驗在意的是兩個元件之間的相對位移，而非桌面對地的絕對運動。隔振後，樓板傳入的剛體運動大多是共模，經桌面彎曲轉成的差模極小；真正主導長時間穩定度的是溫度：鋼的熱膨脹係數約 12 ppm/K，空氣折射率隨溫度變化約 −9.3×10⁻⁷/K，氣流與空調週期會讓光程在分鐘尺度漂移。聲壓則透過鏡架與立柱的機械共振直接激振元件，因此預算表要把熱、折射、聲學與殘餘振動分項列出後以 RSS 合成。~Experiments on a platform care about relative displacement between two components, not the top's absolute motion relative to the ground. After isolation, most rigid-body motion from the floor is common-mode and the differential part converted by table bending is tiny; what dominates long-term stability is temperature, since steel expands about 12 ppm/K and the refractive index of air changes about −9.3×10⁻⁷/K, so airflow and HVAC cycles drift optical paths over minutes. Sound pressure drives components directly through mount and post resonances, so the budget lists thermal, refractive, acoustic and residual-vibration terms separately and combines them by RSS.
units.model: 兩元件相距 0.5 m、溫度變化 0.1 K：鋼 12×10⁻⁶×0.5×0.1 = 600 nm；殷鋼 1.2×10⁻⁶ 時 60 nm；空氣光程 9.3×10⁻⁷×0.5×0.1 ≈ 47 nm。70 dB 聲壓為 20 µPa×10^(70/20) ≈ 0.063 Pa，作用在 0.01 m² 的鏡架面上約 0.63 mN；鏡架剛度 10⁶ N/m 時靜態 0.63 nm，若聲頻落在 Q = 30 的鏡架共振則約 19 nm。~Two components 0.5 m apart under a 0.1 K change: steel gives 12×10⁻⁶×0.5×0.1 = 600 nm, Invar at 1.2×10⁻⁶ gives 60 nm, and the air path 9.3×10⁻⁷×0.5×0.1 ≈ 47 nm. A 70 dB sound pressure is 20 µPa×10^(70/20) ≈ 0.063 Pa, about 0.63 mN on a 0.01 m² mount face; with a mount stiffness of 10⁶ N/m that is 0.63 nm statically, but about 19 nm if the tone hits a Q = 30 mount resonance.
units.verify: 在桌面上架一組參考干涉儀或電容位移計量兩點間相對位移，同時記錄桌面與空氣溫度、聲壓與地面振動，以相干分析把相對位移頻譜分配到各來源；再分別開關空調、加罩、播放測試音，逐項核對預算表的預測。~Mount a reference interferometer or capacitive gauge on the top to measure relative displacement between two points while logging tabletop and air temperature, sound pressure and floor vibration; use coherence analysis to assign the relative-displacement spectrum to each source, then switch HVAC, add an enclosure or play test tones to check each budget line.
units.failure: 把所有心力放在升級隔振腳，卻忽略空調出風口正對光路，干涉訊號仍在數分鐘週期內漂移數百奈米；這類漂移與振動頻譜無關，換再好的隔振器也不會改善。~Investing everything in better legs while an HVAC outlet blows across the beam path still leaves the interference signal drifting hundreds of nanometres with a period of minutes; such drift is unrelated to the vibration spectrum and no isolator upgrade will fix it.
units.misconception: 只要隔振夠好，光路就不會漂移。~Good enough isolation means optical paths cannot drift.

units.anchor: 主動隔振控制迴路~Active isolation control loop
units.title: 主動隔振、傾斜耦合與酬載整合~Active isolation, tilt coupling and payload integration
units.mechanism: 被動隔振在 f₀ 附近放大、低於 f₀ 完全無效；主動隔振以慣性感測器量桌面絕對運動，經控制器驅動音圈或壓電致動器把運動抵消，可在 0.5 到 10 Hz 提供 20 到 30 dB 的額外衰減並大幅壓低共振峰，常用於電子顯微鏡、AFM 與微影設備。主動系統的極限來自感測器：水平慣性感測器無法區分水平加速度與地面傾斜造成的重力分量 g·θ，低頻時傾斜雜訊會被當成運動注入桌面。此外，酬載的重心高度、本身的結構共振與桌面耦合，會限制控制頻寬並可能造成不穩定。~Passive isolation amplifies near f0 and does nothing below it; active isolation measures the top's absolute motion with inertial sensors and drives voice-coil or piezo actuators to cancel it, adding 20 to 30 dB of attenuation from 0.5 to 10 Hz and suppressing the resonant peak, which is why it is common under electron microscopes, AFMs and lithography tools. Its limit is the sensor: a horizontal inertial sensor cannot distinguish horizontal acceleration from the gravity component g·θ due to ground tilt, so at low frequency tilt noise is read as motion and injected into the top. In addition, payload center-of-gravity height, the payload's own structural resonances and their coupling to the top limit control bandwidth and can cause instability.
units.model: 傾斜 θ = 1 nrad 產生的假加速度 g·θ ≈ 9.8×10⁻⁹ m/s²，換成位移 x = gθ/(2πf)²：0.1 Hz 時約 25 nm，0.05 Hz 時約 99 nm，因此水平主動迴路在約 0.1 Hz 以下必須降低增益或混入傾斜感測器。在 3 Hz 迴路增益 G = 30 時，殘餘運動降為被動值的 1/(1 + G) ≈ 0.032（約 −30 dB）。~A tilt θ = 1 nrad produces a false acceleration g·θ ≈ 9.8×10⁻⁹ m/s², equivalent to a displacement x = gθ/(2πf)² of about 25 nm at 0.1 Hz and 99 nm at 0.05 Hz, so a horizontal active loop must roll off its gain or blend in tilt sensors below about 0.1 Hz. With a loop gain G = 30 at 3 Hz, residual motion falls to 1/(1 + G) ≈ 0.032 of the passive value, about −30 dB.
units.verify: 量開迴路與閉迴路傳遞率，確認 0.5 到 10 Hz 的改善量並檢查迴路相位裕度大於約 30°；在桌面上加入或移動酬載後重測，確認沒有新的振盪；同時記錄低頻水平感測器輸出與傾斜計，檢查兩者在 0.1 Hz 以下是否高度相干。~Measure open- and closed-loop transmissibility to confirm the improvement from 0.5 to 10 Hz and check that loop phase margin exceeds about 30°; re-measure after adding or moving payload to confirm no new oscillation; log the low-frequency horizontal sensor output together with a tiltmeter and check whether they are highly coherent below 0.1 Hz.
units.failure: 在主動平台上加裝高而柔的酬載（例如長立柱上的真空腔），其擺動模態落在控制頻寬內，迴路相位被吃掉，平台在數 Hz 自激振盪，振幅比關閉主動控制時還大。~Adding a tall, compliant payload such as a vacuum chamber on a long column puts its rocking mode inside the control bandwidth, eats the loop's phase, and makes the platform self-oscillate at a few hertz with more amplitude than with active control switched off.
units.misconception: 主動隔振可以消除所有頻率的振動，包括 0.01 Hz 的長週期晃動。~Active isolation removes vibration at every frequency, including 0.01 Hz long-period sway.

units.anchor: 管線、纜線與驗收紀錄~Hoses, cables and acceptance record
units.title: 現場安裝、振動短路與驗收交接~Site installation, vibration short circuits and acceptance handoff
units.mechanism: 實驗室中的平台很少只靠隔振腳支撐：真空管、冷卻水管、電纜與光纖都把桌面和地面或振動源直接相連，形成繞過隔振器的振動短路。這些路徑的剛度與隔振器並聯，提高等效 f₀，更嚴重的是把泵或冷卻機的振動直接送上桌面。安裝時要讓管線以柔性迴圈先錨定在地面或獨立支架上，再接到桌面；驗收則在實際運轉狀態（泵、冷卻機、空調全開）量測桌面頻譜、傳遞率、柔度、沉降時間與溫度漂移，並把基準資料交接給使用者以便日後比對。~In a real laboratory a platform rarely rests on its legs alone: vacuum hoses, cooling-water lines, cables and fibres tie the top directly to the floor or to vibration sources, forming short circuits that bypass the isolators. Their stiffness acts in parallel with the isolators and raises the effective f0, and worse, they carry pump or chiller vibration straight onto the top. Installation should route lines in compliant loops anchored first to the floor or an independent stand before reaching the top; acceptance then measures the tabletop spectrum, transmissibility, compliance, settling time and thermal drift under real operating conditions with pumps, chillers and HVAC running, and hands the baseline data to users for later comparison.
units.model: 1000 kg 桌面、f₀ = 1.5 Hz 時隔振器總剛度 k = m(2πf₀)² ≈ 8.9×10⁴ N/m；並聯一條 2×10⁴ N/m 的真空波紋管後 f₀ 升到 1.5×√(1.09×10⁵/8.9×10⁴) ≈ 1.66 Hz。更關鍵的是直接路徑：泵端 25 Hz、1 µm 的振動經波紋管傳到桌面約 k_c/(mω²)×1 µm = 2×10⁴/(1000×(2π×25)²)×1 µm ≈ 0.81 nm，與 VC-C 樓板經隔振器傳入的約 1.0 nm 同一量級。~For a 1000 kg top with f0 = 1.5 Hz, the total isolator stiffness is k = m(2πf0)² ≈ 8.9×10⁴ N/m; adding a 2×10⁴ N/m vacuum bellows in parallel raises f0 to 1.5×√(1.09×10⁵/8.9×10⁴) ≈ 1.66 Hz. The direct path matters more: 1 µm of 25 Hz motion at the pump end reaches the top as about k_c/(mω²)×1 µm = 2×10⁴/(1000×(2π×25)²)×1 µm ≈ 0.81 nm, the same order as the roughly 1.0 nm arriving from a VC-C floor through the isolators.
units.verify: 驗收分兩次量：先拆除所有管線量純隔振器基準，再接上全部管線並讓設備實際運轉量一次，兩者頻譜相減即為短路路徑的貢獻；另以 50 kg 負載偏心加載量沉降時間與水平恢復，24 小時溫度與相對位移紀錄一併歸檔。~Measure acceptance twice: first with all lines removed to record the bare-isolator baseline, then with every line connected and equipment running; the spectral difference is the short-circuit contribution. Also apply an off-center 50 kg load to measure settling time and level recovery, and archive a 24-hour record of temperature and relative displacement with the results.
units.failure: 交接後使用者為了整齊，把纜線用束帶緊緊固定在桌腳與桌面之間，10 到 50 Hz 的隔振效果損失一個數量級，卻沒有人拿半年前的驗收頻譜比對，問題被誤判為樓板惡化。~After handoff, users tidy cables by strapping them tightly between the legs and the top, losing an order of magnitude of isolation from 10 to 50 Hz, yet nobody compares against the acceptance spectrum from six months earlier and the problem is misdiagnosed as a deteriorating floor.
units.misconception: 纜線很軟，對隔振效果沒有影響。~Cables are soft, so they have no effect on isolation.

example: 干涉儀穩定度練習：一台 Michelson 干涉儀放在 1000 kg 蜂巢桌上，兩臂長度差 0.5 m，要求 10 分鐘內相對光程漂移小於 20 nm；樓板為 VC-C，隔振器 f₀ = 1.5 Hz、ζ = 0.1。振動項：8 Hz 頻帶桌面絕對運動 13.2 nm，加速度 a = (2π×8)²×13.2 nm ≈ 3.3×10⁻⁵ m/s²，經 270 Hz 第一彎曲模態轉成的差模 δ ≈ a/ω₁² ≈ 1.2×10⁻¹¹ m，可忽略。未加罩時 10 分鐘溫度變化 0.1 K：鋼 600 nm、空氣 47 nm、70 dB 聲壓激起鏡架共振 19 nm，RSS ≈ 602 nm，超出 30 倍。改善：加隔熱隔音罩使 ΔT 降到 0.01 K、聲壓降 20 dB，並把臂長差縮到 0.05 m：鋼 12×10⁻⁶×0.05×0.01 = 6 nm、空氣 0.47 nm、聲學 1.9 nm，RSS ≈ 6.3 nm，達標。結論：隔振之後，預算由熱與聲學主導。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。~Interferometer stability exercise: a Michelson interferometer sits on a 1000 kg honeycomb table with an arm-length difference of 0.5 m and must hold relative path drift below 20 nm over 10 minutes; the floor is VC-C and the isolators have f0 = 1.5 Hz and ζ = 0.1. Vibration term: the 8 Hz band moves the top 13.2 nm absolutely, an acceleration a = (2π×8)²×13.2 nm ≈ 3.3×10⁻⁵ m/s², which the 270 Hz first bending mode converts to a differential δ ≈ a/ω1² ≈ 1.2×10⁻¹¹ m, negligible. Without an enclosure a 0.1 K change in 10 minutes gives steel 600 nm, air 47 nm and a 70 dB tone exciting a mount resonance 19 nm, an RSS of about 602 nm, thirty times over. Fix: a thermal and acoustic enclosure cuts ΔT to 0.01 K and sound by 20 dB, and the arm difference is reduced to 0.05 m, giving steel 12×10⁻⁶×0.05×0.01 = 6 nm, air 0.47 nm and acoustics 1.9 nm, an RSS of about 6.3 nm, within budget. Conclusion: once isolated, the budget is dominated by thermal and acoustic terms. Values are teaching assumptions, not any product's specification.
history: 1960 年代雷射與全像術出現後，干涉實驗需要次波長級穩定，早期實驗室使用花崗岩板、沙箱或充氣內胎；隨後鋼製蜂巢桌面與氣墊隔振腳商品化，成為光學實驗室的標準配備。1991 年 Colin Gordon 提出通用振動準則 VC 曲線，讓半導體廠與奈米實驗室能以 rms 速度頻譜規範樓板；1990 年代起主動隔振普及到電子顯微鏡與微影設備，Advanced LIGO 更以多級主動平台搭配四段擺，把地面運動壓低多個數量級。本課只重建公開物理與工程邏輯。~After lasers and holography appeared in the 1960s, interference experiments needed sub-wavelength stability, and early laboratories used granite slabs, sand tables or inflated inner tubes; steel honeycomb tops and pneumatic legs were then commercialized and became standard optical-laboratory equipment. In 1991 Colin Gordon proposed the generic vibration criteria, the VC curves, letting semiconductor fabs and nanotechnology laboratories specify floors as rms velocity spectra; from the 1990s active isolation spread to electron microscopes and lithography tools, and Advanced LIGO combines multi-stage active platforms with quadruple pendulums to suppress ground motion by many orders of magnitude. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.
